jsonLd.name: Cape Cod Cannabis
jsonLd.description: Cape Cod Cannabis is a licensed adult-use recreational cannabis dispensary located in Wellfleet, Massachusetts, in the South Wellfleet area of Cape Cod. Serving Cape Cod residents and visitors since 2021, Cape Cod Cannabis provides cannabis education, knowledgeable product guidance, online ordering, in-store pickup, free parking, and a welcoming shopping experience.

itemOffered.name: Cannabis Education
itemOffered.description: Approachable education about cannabis products, cannabinoids, terpenes, consumption methods, Massachusetts regulations, and responsible adult-use.

itemOffered.name: Product Guidance
itemOffered.description: Knowledgeable assistance comparing cannabis products and understanding available options based on individual preferences and experience levels.

itemOffered.name: First Time Visitor Assistance
itemOffered.description: Friendly, pressure free guidance for adults visiting a recreational cannabis dispensary for the first time.

itemOffered.name: Online Ordering
itemOffered.description: Customers can browse the current online menu and reserve available products before visiting the South Wellfleet store.

itemOffered.name: In Store Pickup
itemOffered.description: Online orders may be picked up at the Cape Cod Cannabis Route 6 location in South Wellfleet.

Required for the Job:

 

  • 21+
  • Valid Driver’s License
  • Demonstrate attention to detail
  • Organized and tidy
  • Excellent time management skills
  • Clear communicator that can receive and deliver verbal and written messages
  • Understand and comply with all compliance and regulatory requirements
  • Willingness to learn new skills and adapt to change
  • Showcases confidence, positive attitude, and solution-driven approach to challenges
  • Comfortable using computers
  • Excellent customer service skills
  • Embraced new experiences and meeting people
  • Reliably commute to Wellfleet, Massachusetts
 

Responsibilities:

 

  • Greet all customers and visitors who arrive on-premises as the first-point-of-contact
  • Maintain a safe shopping environment for customers and employees
  • Follow and enforce all applicable town, state laws, and CCC (Cannabis Control Commission) regulations
  • Check that identification is valid, government-issued, and proof of age
  • Monitor security cameras to observe activity on the interior and exterior of the store
  • Work to prevent loitering, trespassing, and consumption on the premises
  • Escalate security threats to appropriate authorities as necessary, and as appropriate
  • Ensure that the reception area floors and surfaces are clean and sanitized regularly
  • Stay informed of sales activities, events, and specials
  • Display professional and courteous verbal and non-verbal communication with customers and visitors
  • Maintain a calm and welcoming environment

 

After being selected you must pass all required background checks and obtain the necessary State certification prior to commencing work.

 

Job Types: Full-time and Part-time
Wellfleet, MA

Description:

As a Product Specialist, you will assist and guide customers through their retail experience, while accurately and efficiently processing transactions in accordance with 

all rules and regulations put forth by Cape Cod Cannabis and the Cannabis Control Commission.

  • 21+
  • Valid Driver’s License
  • Demonstrate attention to detail
  • Organized and tidy
  • Excellent time management skills
  • Clear communicator that can receive and deliver verbal and written messages
  • Understand and comply with all compliance and regulatory requirements
  • Willingness to learn new skills and adapt to change
  • Showcases confidence, positive attitude, and solution-driven approach to challenges
  • Comfortable using computers
  • Excellent customer service skills
  • Embraced new experiences and meeting people
  • Reliably commute to Wellfleet, Massachusetts

 

Qualifications to be an excellent Product Specialist:

  • Minimum 2 years experience with customer service in a fast-paced retail environment
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to solve and resolve problems in a calm,
  • Professional, and courteous manner
  • Exceptional customer service skills
  • Personal interest in the cannabis industry and enthusiasm for learning
  • Dynamic interpersonal and communication skills
  • A highly self-motivated and ethical individual
 
Responsibilities:
  • Educate and assist customers in making product selections
  • Maintain awareness of the current menu, programs, pricing, and deals

  • Ensure compliance of operations with the State laws and Company’s policies and procedures
  • Maintain high ethical standards and professionalism
  • May be required to lift up to 40 pounds
  • After being selected you must pass all required background checks and obtain necessary
  • State certification prior to commencing work.

blocks.text: Trusted by Cape Cod Residents and Visitors Since 2021

blocks.html:
Choosing a cannabis dispensary is about more than finding the closest location. It’s about finding knowledgeable people, quality products, and a place you can trust.

Since opening in 2021, Cape Cod Cannabis has proudly served Cape Cod residents and visitors with a commitment to education, exceptional customer service, and responsible cannabis retail. Conveniently located in the Route 6 shopping plaza in South Wellfleet, we welcome customers from Provincetown to Sandwich and beyond, and everywhere in between.

Whether you’re visiting Cape Cod for a weekend getaway or you’re a year-round resident, our goal is simple: provide a welcoming, informative, and comfortable shopping experience while helping every customer make confident, informed cannabis decisions.

At Cape Cod Cannabis, trust is earned through consistency, transparency, and a genuine commitment to our customers.

We believe every customer deserves friendly service, knowledgeable guidance, and access to quality recreational cannabis products in a welcoming environment. Whether you’re exploring cannabis for the first time or have years of experience, our team is here to answer your questions, explain your options, and help you find products that best fit your preferences.

Since 2021, we’ve built lasting relationships with thousands of customers by focusing on education before recommendations, honesty before sales, and exceptional service during every visit.
Flower • Pre-Rolls • Edibles • Vaporizers • Concentrates • Tinctures • Topicals • CBD • Seeds • Accessories • Apparel

Our customers consistently describe their experience at Cape Cod Cannabis as friendly, welcoming, and informative.

Across hundreds of Google reviews, customers frequently mention:

  • Friendly and welcoming staff
  • Knowledgeable product recommendations
  • One of Cape Cod’s largest selections of cannabis products
  • A comfortable experience for first-time visitors
  • Convenient Route 6 location with free parking
  • Easy online ordering and in-store pickup
  • Professional, educational approach to cannabis
  • Great product variety and value
  • Helpful guidance without pressure
  • A shopping experience that’s always worth the trip

These recurring themes reflect the experience we strive to provide every day.

Responsible and informative education is at the heart of everything we do.

Cannabis affects everyone differently, which is why we believe informed customers make better decisions. Our knowledgeable team takes the time to answer questions, explain products, discuss different consumption methods, and help customers understand the differences between flower, pre-rolls, edibles, vaporizers, concentrates, tinctures, CBD products, seeds, and more. We also offer our Intro to Cannabis 101 page for your reference.

Whether you’re new to cannabis or an experienced consumer, we’re committed to providing clear, honest information so you can shop with confidence.

Cape Cod Cannabis proudly serves customers from across Cape Cod and beyond, including:

  • Provincetown
  • Truro
  • Wellfleet
  • Eastham
  • Orleans
  • Brewster
  • Harwich
  • Chatham
  • Dennis
  • Yarmouth
  • Hyannis
  • Barnstable
  • Mashpee
  • Falmouth
  • Sandwich

We also welcome thousands of visitors who make Cape Cod Cannabis a stop during their Cape Cod vacation. Conveniently located directly on Route 6 in the South Wellfleet shopping plaza, we’re easy to find with plenty of free parking.

We’re committed to operating responsibly while providing a safe, welcoming, and educational environment for every customer.

Our commitment includes:

  • Providing quality, licensed recreational cannabis products
  • Helping customers make informed purchasing decisions
  • Promoting responsible cannabis consumption
  • Supporting our local Cape Cod community
  • Maintaining a clean, professional, and welcoming retail environment
  • Continuously expanding our knowledge to better serve our customers

Every customer interaction is an opportunity to build trust, answer questions, and provide an exceptional experience.

blocks.text: Why It’s Always Worth the Trip

blocks.html:
Cape Cod Cannabis has become a trusted destination for both Cape Cod residents and visitors seeking quality recreational cannabis products, knowledgeable guidance, and outstanding customer service.

Whether you’re traveling from a neighboring town or making Cape Cod part of your vacation, we invite you to discover why so many customers continue to choose Cape Cod Cannabis year after year.

From our extensive product selection and friendly team to our convenient South Wellfleet location, we’re committed to providing an experience that’s informative, welcoming, and always worth the trip.

We look forward to welcoming you soon.
